description: This file defines an ErrorHandler class for structured exception handling and error reporting in a distributed PyTorch environment, including methods for initializing fault handlers, recording exceptions, and managing error files.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: A class for handling errors by writing structured JSON exception data to files or logs, with methods for initialization, exception recording, and error file management.

methods.name: _get_error_file_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the error file from environment variable or None.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up fault handlers; can be overridden for custom initialization.

methods.name: _write_error_file
methods.description: Writes an error message to a specified file.

methods.name: record_exception
methods.description: Records exception details in a JSON format to the error file or logs if file path is unavailable.

methods.name: override_error_code_in_rootcause_data
methods.description: Modifies the root cause error data to set the correct exit error code.

methods.name: dump_error_file
methods.description: Loads a root cause error file, optionally overrides error code, and writes it to the error file specified by environment.

methods.name: _rm
methods.description: Removes an existing error file after logging its contents.
